g.text: Public web services + reverse proxy to home server • Docker Compose
• Security: Authelia SSO (2FA) • CrowdSec • Geoblock • Docker Socket Proxy
• Cloud apps: Plausible Analytics, Obtainium Apps, Uptime Kuma, Owncast, etc.
• Requests to *.home.$DOMAIN proxied to srv0 via FRP tunnel
Main home server • K8s control plane
• Observability: Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Grafana, Ntfy
• Serves apps: Immich, Jellyfin, Frigate, Home Assistant, Nextcloud, etc.
Gaming PC (AMD RX 9070) • GPU-accelerated K8s worker
• Powers GPU-heavy workloads like Ollama for local AI
• Syncthing: Continuous 2-way P2P folder sync (pc ⇄ srv0)
• Streams RTSP feed to srv0's Frigate NVR
